name: pr-this
description: Understand any commit, branch comparison, or working change at a glance. Zoom from a one-line intent down to line-level explanations, powered by local or cloud AI. How-to video: https://youtu.be/p0EruS_rgww
author: Mosca IT LLC

untrustedWorkspaces.description: PR This runs git in the workspace and sends its changes to an AI provider, so it only runs in trusted workspaces.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Open a folder that is a git repository to explore its changes.
[Open Change Lens](command:prThis.open)

scm/resourceGroup/context.when: scmProvider == git && (scmResourceGroup == index || scmResourceGroup == workingTree || scmResourceGroup == untracked) && config.prThis.commitMessages != off

enumDescriptions: Ollama running locally (OpenAI-compatible endpoint)
LM Studio local server
Any OpenAI-compatible server (vLLM, llama.cpp, LiteLLM, OpenRouter, …)

OpenZiti LLM Gateway (openziti/llm-gateway). Routes each request to OpenAI, Anthropic, or self-hosted models by model name, so PR This treats it as a cloud provider even on localhost. zrok is optional.

prThis.provider.description: AI provider used to explain changes. Can only be set in user settings, so a workspace cannot redirect your API keys.

prThis.model.description: Model name. Leave empty to use the provider default. Can only be set in user settings.

prThis.baseUrl.description: Override the provider base URL (e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1). Can only be set in user settings, so a workspace cannot send your API key to another server.

enumDescriptions: Open changed files in the background (no editor tabs) so your language extensions and linters analyse them. Results appear without opening each file yourself.
Only use problems your language extensions have already reported, which is usually just for files open in an editor.
Don't show static analysis results or send them to the AI.
prThis.staticAnalysis.markdownDescription: Show problems that your language extensions and linters (TypeScript, ESLint, Pylance, …) report on the changed lines, and pass them to the AI. PR This runs no analysis of its own. For a commit or branch comparison, results are only shown for files whose content on disk still matches that version.

enumDescriptions: Use the provider's default
Fastest and cheapest; least thinking
Balanced (recommended)
Most thorough; slowest
prThis.reasoningEffort.description: How long reasoning models think before answering: current Claude models, OpenAI reasoning models (o-series, GPT-5), and Ollama thinking models (set to 'high' to enable thinking on Ollama; off otherwise for faster local responses). Lower is faster and cheaper; higher can catch more subtle problems.

prThis.maxDiffChars.description: Maximum characters of diff sent to the model for the overview (local providers default to 24000 unless explicitly set). Can only be set in user settings.

prThis.ollamaContextLength.description: Maximum context window (num_ctx) requested from Ollama; automatically sized down to 8k/16k/32k tiers when the prompt is smaller.

prThis.excludeFromAI.description: Glob patterns whose diffs are listed but not sent to the AI (lock files, generated code, …). Secret files (.env, keys, certificates, .npmrc, …) are always left out as well; see prThis.sendSecretFiles.

prThis.sendSecretFiles.description: Send the diffs of files that commonly hold secrets (.env, private keys, certificates, .npmrc, .netrc, …) to the AI. Off by default; templates such as .env.example and public keys are always sent. Can only be set in user settings.

prThis.explanationLanguage.description: Language the AI should write explanations in.

prThis.commitCount.description: Number of recent commits to list.

enumDescriptions: Write a detailed and a condensed commit message for the uncommitted changes in the background, a few seconds after they last change
Write each commit message only when you click its row under Uncommitted changes
Turn commit message suggestions off and hide their rows, buttons and command
prThis.commitMessages.markdownDescription: Commit message suggestions under **Uncommitted changes** in the PR This view: a detailed one (subject and body) and a condensed one (one line), for the staged changes when anything is staged, otherwise all uncommitted changes. Messages are cached by the change itself, so they are only written again when the files change or you click **Regenerate**. In `background` mode your uncommitted changes are sent to the configured AI provider without a click, whenever they change. Can only be set in user settings.

enumDescriptions: Share the overview's diff budget by file size (small files first)
Ask a local decision engine (vej, jev-local, or llama.cpp with /v1/systemone) how central each file is, and give important files a larger share of the overview's diff budget
prThis.decisionEngine.markdownDescription: Experimental. When a change is too large for `#prThis.maxDiffChars#`, score each file's relevance with a local "System 1" decision engine so the overview keeps the files that matter. Only used when the diff must be trimmed, and only with a server on this machine. Scores and timings are logged to the **PR This** output channel. Falls back to the size-based budget if the engine is not running. Can only be set in user settings.

prThis.decisionEngineUrl.markdownDescription: Address of the decision engine serving `POST /v1/systemone` (and `/v1/systemone/batch` when available). Must be on this machine (localhost or 127.x). vej and the OpenZiti LLM Gateway both default to port 8080, so run one of them on another port if you use both. Can only be set in user settings.

prThis.decisionEngineModel.markdownDescription: Model the decision engine scores with, e.g. `llama-3.2-1b`. Leave empty for the server's default.

prThis.decisionEngineTimeoutMs.markdownDescription: How long to wait for relevance scores before falling back to the size-based budget. The first request may load the model.

enumDescriptions: Pre-warm in the background only when using a local model (Ollama, LM Studio, or local OpenAI-compatible server)
Pre-warm in the background for all providers
Never run background pre-warming
prThis.backgroundPrewarm.description: Pre-compute explanations in the background (HEAD commit and top review-focus files) while idle, and immediately yield whenever you start an interactive action. Can only be set in user settings.
